_doc: Stocks: one market per listed token per New York trading session (see open-markets.mjs). Pre-IPO tokens (category preipo, kind day) settle on their on-chain price: one market per UTC day, three ranges cut at +-thresholdsBps around the previous day's close (prices.mjs chainMove); thresholds = the token's median absolute daily move over 60 days on GeckoTerminal (T-OpenAI 1.02 %, T-Kalshi 0.99 %, PreStocks OPENAI 3.11 %, 2026-09-16). faucetUi = devnet faucet amount in shares (default 2). A stock can trade on Solana as several tokens from different issuers (xStocks, Backpack Securities, Ondo Global Markets); each token gets its own pool, since the tokens are not interchangeable. All pools of a stock share the stock's thresholds and resolve on the same official close. thresholdsBps are chosen near the quartiles of the stock's daily moves (TSLA/NVDA/SPY: 12 weeks to 2026-09-11 from Alpaca SIP; SPCX: all 63 sessions since listing, Yahoo) with the middle cut at 0, so the four ranges read big drop / small drop / small gain / big gain. On-chain thresholds are in ppm (bps x 100). seed = fee-free prize in shares of that token; profile = which issuer's Token-2022 extension set the devnet mock copies.
